source.statement: WITH d AS (SELECT "sku", "warehouse_id", SUM("qty_shipped")/28.0 AS daily FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_SALES_ORDERS WHERE "order_date" >= DATEADD(day,-28,CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1,2), b AS (SELECT x.*, DATEDIFF(day,CURRENT_DATE,x."expiry_date") AS dte, COALESCE(d.daily,0) AS daily, COALESCE(SUM(x."qty_on_hand") OVER (PARTITION BY x."sku",x."warehouse_id" ORDER BY x."expiry_date",x."batch_id" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) AS ahead FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES x LEFT JOIN d ON d."sku"=x."sku" AND d."warehouse_id"=x."warehouse_id" WHERE x."qty_on_hand">0) SELECT b."batch_id" AS batch_id, b."sku" AS sku, p."product_name" AS product_name, p."category" AS category, b."warehouse_id" AS warehouse_id, b."status" AS status, b."received_date" AS received_date, b."expiry_date" AS expiry_date, b.dte AS days_to_expiry, CASE WHEN b.dte<=30 THEN '0-30 days' WHEN b.dte<=60 THEN '31-60 days' WHEN b.dte<=90 THEN '61-90 days' WHEN b.dte<=180 THEN '91-180 days' ELSE '180+ days' END AS expiry_band, b."qty_on_hand" AS qty_on_hand, b."qty_on_hand"*b."unit_cost_gbp" AS stock_value_gbp, ROUND(b.daily,1) AS daily_run_rate, ROUND(b."qty_on_hand"-GREATEST(0,LEAST(b."qty_on_hand",b.daily*b.dte-b.ahead))) AS qty_at_risk, ROUND((b."qty_on_hand"-GREATEST(0,LEAST(b."qty_on_hand",b.daily*b.dte-b.ahead)))*b."unit_cost_gbp",2) AS value_at_risk_gbp FROM b JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PRODUCTS p ON p."sku"=b."sku"

Batch Rotation.description: One row per live batch, with days to expiry and FEFO-projected quantity at risk of expiring unsold, using the last 28 days of shipments as the run rate.

source.statement: WITH k AS (SELECT p."sku", p."product_name", p."category", p."supplier_id", p."reorder_cover_days", w."warehouse_id" FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PRODUCTS p CROSS JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_WAREHOUSES w), s AS (SELECT "sku","warehouse_id",SUM(IFF("status"='Available',"qty_on_hand",0)) AS avail, SUM(IFF("status"='Quarantine',"qty_on_hand",0)) AS quar FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES GROUP BY 1,2), d AS (SELECT "sku","warehouse_id",SUM("qty_shipped")/28.0 AS daily FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_SALES_ORDERS WHERE "order_date">=DATEADD(day,-28,CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1,2), o AS (SELECT "sku","warehouse_id",SUM("qty_ordered") AS inbound, MIN("expected_date") AS next_due FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PURCHASE_ORDERS WHERE "status" IN ('Open','Delayed') GROUP BY 1,2), c AS (SELECT k.*, COALESCE(s.avail,0) avail, COALESCE(s.quar,0) quar, COALESCE(d.daily,0) daily, COALESCE(o.inbound,0) inbound, o.next_due FROM k LEFT JOIN s ON s."sku"=k."sku" AND s."warehouse_id"=k."warehouse_id" LEFT JOIN d ON d."sku"=k."sku" AND d."warehouse_id"=k."warehouse_id" LEFT JOIN o ON o."sku"=k."sku" AND o."warehouse_id"=k."warehouse_id") SELECT "sku" AS sku, "product_name" AS product_name, "category" AS category, "supplier_id" AS supplier_id, "warehouse_id" AS warehouse_id, avail AS qty_available, quar AS qty_quarantine, ROUND(daily,1) AS daily_run_rate, ROUND(avail/NULLIF(daily,0),1) AS days_of_cover, "reorder_cover_days" AS reorder_cover_days, inbound AS qty_inbound, next_due AS next_po_due, CASE WHEN avail<daily*7 THEN 'Stockout risk' WHEN avail+inbound<daily*"reorder_cover_days" THEN 'Reorder now' WHEN avail>daily*120 THEN 'Overstocked' ELSE 'Healthy' END AS stock_status, GREATEST(0,CEIL(daily*("reorder_cover_days"+30)-avail-inbound)) AS suggested_order_qty FROM c

Stock Position.description: One row per SKU and warehouse: available stock, run rate, days of cover, inbound purchase orders, reorder status and suggested order quantity.

Period.source: CASE WHEN "movement_date" > DATEADD(day,-30,CURRENT_DATE) THEN 'Last 30d' WHEN "movement_date" > DATEADD(day,-60,CURRENT_DATE) THEN 'Prior 30d' ELSE 'Older' END
CASE WHEN "order_date" > DATEADD(day,-30,CURRENT_DATE) THEN 'Last 30d' WHEN "order_date" > DATEADD(day,-60,CURRENT_DATE) THEN 'Prior 30d' ELSE 'Older' END
CASE WHEN "order_date" > DATEADD(day,-30,CURRENT_DATE) THEN 'Last 30d' WHEN "order_date" > DATEADD(day,-60,CURRENT_DATE) THEN 'Prior 30d' ELSE 'Older' END

Stock Status.description: Stockout risk, Reorder now, Healthy, Overstocked.

Daily Run Rate.description: Units per day over the last 28 days.

Days Of Cover.description: Available units over the daily run rate.

Delayed PO Units.description: Units on POs past their expected date.

Delayed Share.description: Delayed PO units as a share of inbound units.

Net Movement 30d.description: Net change in stock over the last 30 days.

PO Units Ordered.description: Units on purchase orders by order date.

Received Change.description: Received, last 30 days against the prior 30.

Received Prior 30d.description: Units received. The 30 days before that.

Revenue Change.description: Revenue, last 30 days against the prior 30.

Revenue Prior 30d.description: Order revenue, GBP. The 30 days before that.

Shipped 30d.description: Units shipped to customers. Last 30 days.

Shipped Change.description: Shipped, last 30 days against the prior 30.

Shipped Prior 30d.description: Units shipped to customers. The 30 days before that.

Suggested Order Units.description: Units to order to restore cover.

Units At Risk.description: Units projected to expire unsold, FEFO at the 28-day run rate.

Units Available.description: Units available to ship, excluding quarantine.

Units Expired.description: Units lost to expiry or write-off, as a negative total.

Units Expiring 30d.description: Units on hand expiring within 30 days.

Units Inbound.description: Units on open or delayed purchase orders.

Units On Hand.description: Units in live batches, including quarantine.

Units On Hand 30d Ago.description: Units on hand 30 days ago: today less the net movement since.

Units On Hand Change.description: Net movement as a share of stock 30 days ago.

Units Out.description: Units shipped, as a negative movement total.

Value At Risk.description: Cost of units projected to expire unsold, GBP.

Value At Risk Share.description: Value at risk as a share of stock value.

Written Off 30d.description: Units written off, negative. Last 30 days.

Written Off Change.description: Written Off, last 30 days against the prior 30.

Written Off Prior 30d.description: Units written off, negative. The 30 days before that.

Cancel Purchase Order.description: Cancels an Open or Delayed purchase order that has not been received.

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PURCHASE_ORDERS SET "status"='Cancelled' WHERE "po_id"={po_id:string} AND "status" IN ('Open','Delayed') AND COALESCE("qty_received",0)=0
statements.name: cancel

Post Stock Count.description: Sets a batch to its counted quantity and logs the variance as a Count Adjustment.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_MOVEMENTS ("movement_id","movement_date","batch_id","sku","warehouse_id","movement_type","qty","reference","created_by") SELECT 'MV-'||UUID_STRING(),CURRENT_DATE,"batch_id","sku","warehouse_id",'Count Adjustment',{counted:int}-"qty_on_hand",'Stock count','workflow' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string}
statements.name: log_variance

Raise Purchase Order.description: Raises a replenishment PO for a SKU and warehouse, using the product supplier and its lead time for the expected date.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PURCHASE_ORDERS ("po_id","sku","supplier_id","warehouse_id","order_date","expected_date","received_date","qty_ordered","qty_received","status") SELECT 'PO-'||LEFT(UUID_STRING(),8),p."sku",p."supplier_id",{warehouse_id:string},CURRENT_DATE,DATEADD(day,s."lead_time_days",CURRENT_DATE),NULL,{qty:int},0,'Open' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PRODUCTS p JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_SUPPLIERS s ON s."supplier_id"=p."supplier_id" WHERE p."sku"={sku:string}
statements.name: create_po

Recall Batch.description: Quarantines all remaining Available stock of a batch and its transferred child batches.

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES SET "status"='Quarantine' WHERE ("batch_id"={batch_id:string} OR STARTSWITH("batch_id",{batch_id:string}||'-T')) AND "status"='Available'
statements.name: quarantine

parameters.name: expiry_date
parameters.description: Expiry date printed on the batch

Receive Purchase Order.description: Goods in: creates a new batch from an open or delayed PO, logs the Receipt movement and closes the PO.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES ("batch_id","sku","warehouse_id","supplier_id","received_date","expiry_date","qty_received","qty_on_hand","unit_cost_gbp","status") SELECT 'B-'||o."po_id",o."sku",o."warehouse_id",o."supplier_id",CURRENT_DATE,{expiry_date:date},{qty_received:int},{qty_received:int},p."unit_cost_gbp",'Available' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PURCHASE_ORDERS o JOIN ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PRODUCTS p ON p."sku"=o."sku" WHERE o."po_id"={po_id:string} AND o."status" IN ('Open','Delayed')
statements.name: create_batch

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_MOVEMENTS ("movement_id","movement_date","batch_id","sku","warehouse_id","movement_type","qty","reference","created_by") SELECT 'MV-'||UUID_STRING(),CURRENT_DATE,'B-'||"po_id","sku","warehouse_id",'Receipt',{qty_received:int},"po_id",'workflow' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_PURCHASE_ORDERS WHERE "po_id"={po_id:string} AND "status" IN ('Open','Delayed')
statements.name: log_movement

Record Dispatch.description: Goods out: ships units from a named batch. Refused unless the batch is Available and holds enough stock.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_MOVEMENTS ("movement_id","movement_date","batch_id","sku","warehouse_id","movement_type","qty","reference","created_by") SELECT 'MV-'||UUID_STRING(),CURRENT_DATE,"batch_id","sku","warehouse_id",'Customer Shipment',-{qty:int},{reference:string},'workflow' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string} AND "status"='Available' AND "qty_on_hand">={qty:int}
statements.name: log_movement

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES SET "qty_on_hand"="qty_on_hand"-{qty:int} WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string} AND "status"='Available' AND "qty_on_hand">={qty:int}
statements.name: decrement

Set Batch Status.description: Places a live batch in Quarantine or releases it back to Available. Quarantined stock is excluded from available stock.

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES SET "status"={new_status:string} WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string} AND "qty_on_hand">0 AND "status" IN ('Available','Quarantine') AND {new_status:string} IN ('Available','Quarantine')
statements.name: set_status

Transfer Stock.description: Moves units of an Available batch to the other warehouse as a child batch keeping its expiry, and logs both movements.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES ("batch_id","sku","warehouse_id","supplier_id","received_date","expiry_date","qty_received","qty_on_hand","unit_cost_gbp","status") SELECT {new_batch_id:string},"sku",IFF("warehouse_id"='WH-UK','WH-US','WH-UK'),"supplier_id","received_date","expiry_date",{qty:int},{qty:int},"unit_cost_gbp",'Available' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string} AND "status"='Available' AND "qty_on_hand">={qty:int}
statements.name: create_child

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_MOVEMENTS ("movement_id","movement_date","batch_id","sku","warehouse_id","movement_type","qty","reference","created_by") SELECT 'MV-'||UUID_STRING(),CURRENT_DATE,"batch_id","sku","warehouse_id",'Transfer Out',-{qty:int},{new_batch_id:string},'workflow' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string} AND "status"='Available' AND "qty_on_hand">={qty:int}
statements.name: log_out

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_MOVEMENTS ("movement_id","movement_date","batch_id","sku","warehouse_id","movement_type","qty","reference","created_by") SELECT 'MV-'||UUID_STRING(),CURRENT_DATE,"batch_id","sku","warehouse_id",'Transfer In',{qty:int},{batch_id:string},'workflow' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES WHERE "batch_id"={new_batch_id:string}
statements.name: log_in

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES SET "qty_on_hand"="qty_on_hand"-{qty:int} WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string} AND "status"='Available' AND "qty_on_hand">={qty:int}
statements.name: decrement

Write Off Batch.description: Writes off all remaining stock in a batch: logs a Manual Write-off movement, zeroes the batch and marks it Written Off.

statements.sql: INSERT INTO ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_MOVEMENTS ("movement_id","movement_date","batch_id","sku","warehouse_id","movement_type","qty","reference","created_by") SELECT 'MV-'||UUID_STRING(),CURRENT_DATE,"batch_id","sku","warehouse_id",'Manual Write-off',-"qty_on_hand",{reason:string},'workflow' FROM ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string} AND "qty_on_hand">0
statements.name: log_movement

statements.sql: UPDATE ASTRATO_GALLERY.ASTRATO.CORVO_INV_BATCHES SET "qty_on_hand"=0,"status"='Written Off' WHERE "batch_id"={batch_id:string} AND "qty_on_hand">0
statements.name: zero_batch
